117790.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of the Maritimes
117790.note: 24 Jan 2008: 'Thirteen years ago, Chabad representatives Rabbi Mendel and Bassie Feldman and one month old Zevi moved to Halifax to stay.' Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) date the move: at the present address by Jan 2015, so it moved there between 2009 and Jan 2015. Retagged Nov 10 from 'anniversary' to 'stated': the year is stated outright by Anash.org: 'since 5755 (1995), when they established' it; the count-back was only how it was first found.

117895.name: Chabad Lubavitch Jewish Center of Merrimack Valley
117895.note: Wicked Local, 1 Oct 2013: Rabbi Asher Bronstein, 'Just like when we came 21 years ago (to Andover)'. Not settled: the Lawrence History Center holds the 'Chabad Lubavitch of the Merrimack Valley First Annual Founders' Dinner' journal, dated only 'c. 1990'; Merrimack Valley Lubavitch Inc.'s IRS ruling is 1994. Checked (Nov 7): its own staff page (https://www.chabadmv.com/templates/articlecco_cdo/aid/2194385/jewish/Our-Rabbis-Rebbetzins.htm): 'Rabbi Asher Bronstein, together with his wife Faigy ... has been serving the local Jews in the Merrimack Valley since 1992'. Two sources agree, so high (the 'c. 1990' founders' dinner journal is undated). Retagged Nov 10 from 'anniversary' to 'stated': the year is stated outright by its own staff page: 'serving ... since 1992'; the count-back was only how it was first found.

117619.name: Lubavitch of Indiana - Chabad Center for Jewish Life
117619.note: Chabad.org (16 Mar 2015, via CrownHeights.info): 'After 34 Years, New Home for Indiana Jewish Community' (Rabbi Avrohom and Nini Grossbaum, 'more than three decades in Indianapolis'). Their son's page: sent by the Rebbe 'in the early 1980's'. therebbesimpact.com: the couple from 1981. Checked (Nov 7): COLlive, June 6 2023 ('Mike Pence Joins Chabad Indiana Gala', https://collive.com/mike-pence-joins-chabad-indiana-gala-before-announcing-run/): 'Chabad of Indiana, led by Shluchim Rabbi Avrohom and Nini Grossbaum and Rabbi Dovid and Chana Grossbaum has been operating in Indiana since 1981', so high. Chabad.org (Mar 15 2015): for three decades they ran services, programs and classes 'from their own home and neighboring Jewish schools and synagogues'; its own building, the Chabad Center for Jewish Life in Carmel, opened on Purim 2015. Retagged Nov 10 from 'anniversary' to 'stated': the year is stated outright by COLlive (2023): 'operating in Indiana since 1981'; the count-back was only how it was first found.

earlier.where: the Grossbaums' home in Indianapolis, and space lent by the Hasten Hebrew Academy, the Arthur M. Glick JCC, Congregation B'nai Torah and Etz Chaim Sephardic Congregation

118352.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Wellington
118352.note: Town-Crier (1 Feb 2013, its 'Bar Mitzvah'): 'Chabad is celebrating 13 years of reaching out to the community'; Rabbi Mendy Muskal: 'Within six weeks of arrival, we already had a group of people for a High Holiday get-together' (so summer 1999). Lubavitch.com (5 Nov 2003): 'When the Muskals took up residence in Wellington in 1999, they invited all three of the Jewish families they knew to a meeting in their living room'; the first High Holidays were in a community meeting room; 'By the second year, they were in a rented public school building'; the Hebrew school met 'in various rental locations and even in the Muskal home'; in Oct 2003 it opened its own center in the Wellington Plaza Shopping Center. Wellington the Magazine (1 Dec 2025): the Muskals have been in Wellington 'for more than 25 years', moving from Kentucky. IRS: 'Chabad Lubavitch Of Wellington Inc', exempt from Feb 2002. Retagged Nov 10 from 'anniversary' to 'stated': the year is stated outright by Lubavitch.com (2003): 'When the Muskals took up residence in Wellington in 1999'; the count-back was only how it was first found.

earlier.where: Wellington: the Muskals' living room, and a community meeting room for its first High Holidays
Wellington: a rented public school building (High Holidays) and various rented rooms for the Hebrew school
